originalTitle: Season 4: Heroes of Busan Official Trailer | Overwatch
content: Let your teamwork do all the talking during Season 4: Heroes of Busan. The leader of MEKA Squad is ready for her highly anticipated debut as our newest Tank Hero, D.Mon! Take the fight straight to Talon and the Junkers with her close range Plasma Saber and protective Power Barrier. D.Mon isn’t the only MEKA Squad pilot showing up this season. During our Shooting Star: My MEKA Mania Event, you’ll get a chance to support your favorite MEKA pilot by completing challenges, earning rewards, and seeing which one is the most popular of them all. Battle Passes are getting revamped this season by letting you choose which track to unlock rewards in first, and by letting you swap an eligible Legendary reward for something in the curated Swap Pool. Competitive is also getting updated with the all-new Emerald Rank, Comp Rank Reset, and the arrival of Team Drives that reward you for teaming up and sticking together as a group. And that’s just the beginning! Look out for brand new map reworks, Mythics, the return of a fan-favorite collab, and so much more. It all starts when Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches in-game tomorrow at 11am PT. chineseContent: 在第 4 季：釜山英雄中，让您的团队合作来说话。 MEKA 小队的队长已准备好以我们最新的坦克英雄 D.Mon 的身份首次亮相，备受期待！凭借她的近距离等离子军刀和保护性能量屏障，直接与泰隆和容克斯战斗。 D.Mon 并不是本赛季唯一出现的 MEKA Squad 飞行员。在我们的流星：我的 MEKA 狂热活动中，您将有机会通过完成挑战、获得奖励以及看看哪一个是最受欢迎的来支持您最喜欢的 MEKA 飞行员。本赛季的战斗通行证进行了改进，让您选择首先解锁奖励的曲目，并让您将符合条件的传奇奖励交换为精心策划的交换池中的东西。竞技模式也随着全新的翡翠排名、竞争排名重置以及团队驱动器的到来而更新，这些团队驱动器奖励您作为一个团队团结起来并团结在一起。这只是开始！留意全新地图重做、神话、粉丝喜爱的合作回归等等。这一切都始于《第 4 季：釜山英雄》于太平洋时间明天上午 11 点在游戏中推出。 《守望先锋》可在 PC 和游戏机上免费畅玩，包括 Nintendo Switch™ 2！ _ 关注 #Overwatch 了解最新消息： Instagram：https://www.instagram.com/playoverwatch TikTok：https://www.tiktok.com/@overwatch Twitter：http://www.twitter.com/playoverwatch Facebook：http://www.facebook.com/playoverwatch
